caption: OOS Sharpe across the tradable monthly lead grid L1–L13. Bars are the best seasonally-CLEAN combo at each lead (the population the winner is drawn from); the vermillion line traces the winner's own signal (trend deviation). The published winner (star) sits at L13 with OOS Sharpe 1.34 — at the very CEILING of the floored lead grid. The grey dotted line (best of ANY signal) peaks higher at L3 (1.47), but that peak rides a seasonally-contaminated transform (the Cass source is NSA) and is excluded. A grid-ceiling, 13-month-lead winner on a coincident series is best read as a likely search artifact requiring adjudication (issue #28).
narrative_alignment_note: Published L13 winner is the best CLEAN combo but sits at the grid ceiling; the taller raw bar at L3 is contaminated and excluded.
